data.name: Bhadrak
data.gender_notes: Bhadrak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhadra' meaning 'auspicious', 'Bhadrak' is a name that signifies blessings and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, 'Bhadrak' is also the name of a demon, Bhadrakalpamsha, who is believed to bring prosperity and wealth. The name is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and tradition. The name Bhadrak carries the meaning “Blessing, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhadrak usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May you be blessed with prosperity and good fortune.
data.etymology: Bhadrak belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhadrak total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
